title: Finite cohomology of the integral dense-open boundary
statement: Let k be algebraically closed and P=(X,A) a curve coefficient pair [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting] whose torsion abelian sheaf A is constructible [def-weil-pbc-constructible-torsion]. Let U be a dense open, and i:Z -> X its closed complement. Encode A as the sheaf F of ULift Z-modules by the canonical integral equivalence E. Put Q=i_*i^*F [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Every H^q(X,Q), taken on its underlying abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], is finite, including q=0. There is no properness or ambient reducedness assumption.

source.place: Tag 0GJA (lemma-restrict-to-open), proof, closed complement and its finite degree-zero stalk product; Tag 095L (lemma-ses-j-shriek)

proof.text: The curve is Noetherian. Density excludes every generic point, so the closed complement is zero-dimensional with finitely many closed points; their residue fields are k. Its reduction is a finite union of spectra of k. Etale cohomology is invariant under reduction.

Finite direct image is exact, and the Leray comparison identifies the cohomology of i_*i^*F with that on Z. Apply the zero-dimensional calculation: every positive-degree group is zero. Relate derived cohomology to Sheaf.H using the recorded comparison.

Degree-zero sections on the finite complement are the finite product of stalks. Pullback and the integral encoding leave the underlying abelian stalks unchanged. Constructibility as a set sheaf makes each of these stalks finite. Thus degree zero is finite, and the zero positive-degree groups are finite. The empty complement gives the zero sheaf.

lean.statement:
theorem dense_open_integral_boundary_finiteness {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (P : CurveCoefficientPair k) (hP : P.IsConstructible)
    (U : P.C.Opens) (hU : Dense (U : Set P.C)) :
    let E := (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} ℤ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).inv ⋙
      ModuleCat.restrictScalars (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{u + 1} ℤ ≃+* ℤ).toRingHom
    let F := (sheafCompose P.C.smallEtaleTopology E).obj P.F
    let Q := (Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ))
      U.closedComplement).obj
        ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)) U.closedComplement).obj F)
    ∀ q : ℕ, Finite (Sheaf.H
      ((sheafCompose P.C.smallEtaleTopology
        (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj Q) q)
